name: hexana-wasm
displayName: Hexana WebAssembly and Native (ELF/PE/Mach-O) Hex Viewer
description: Binary hex viewer and analyzer with a focus on WebAssembly and Native (ELF/PE/Mach-O) formats
author: JetBrains

explorer/context.when: resourceExtname == .o || resourceExtname == .obj || resourceExtname == .so || resourceExtname == .dylib || resourceExtname == .dll || resourceExtname == .exe || resourceExtname == .elf || resourceExtname == .a || resourceExtname == .lib || resourceExtname == .ko || resourceExtname == .sys || resourceExtname == .axf || resourceExtname == .bin || resourceExtname == .out || resourceExtname == ''

wasmFile.description: Path to the .wasm file to debug.

runtime.description: Wasm runtime to use for debugging.

nodePath.description: Custom path to the Node.js executable (for nodejs runtime).

chromePath.description: Custom path to the Chrome/Chromium executable (for browser runtime).

programArgs.description: Command-line arguments passed to the Wasm program.

runtimeOptions.description: Extra runtime CLI options (e.g. wasmtime flags).

configurationSnippets.label: WebAssembly: Debug with Wasmtime
configurationSnippets.description: Launch a Wasm module under Wasmtime with LLDB debugging.

configurationSnippets.label: WebAssembly: Debug with WAMR
configurationSnippets.description: Launch a Wasm module under WAMR with LLDB remote debugging.

configurationSnippets.label: WebAssembly: Debug with Node.js (CDP)
configurationSnippets.description: Launch a Wasm module under Node.js with Chrome DevTools Protocol debugging.

configurationSnippets.label: WebAssembly: Debug with Chrome (CDP)
configurationSnippets.description: Launch a Wasm module in Chrome with Chrome DevTools Protocol debugging.

hexana.enableStatistics.description: Enable anonymous usage statistics collection. When disabled, no analytics events are sent regardless of the global VS Code telemetry setting.

enumDescriptions: Wasmtime — full-featured runtime with Component Model support
WAMR (iwasm) — lightweight runtime for core modules
GraalWasm — GraalVM WebAssembly launcher for core modules
Wazero — zero-dependency Go-based runtime for core modules
Default Browser — run the module in the system browser via a local HTTP server
Node.js — run the module using Node.js built-in WebAssembly API
Show all runtimes every time — display a picker before each run
hexana.wasmRuntime.description: WebAssembly runtime to use when running exports from the hex viewer.

hexana.wasmtimePath.description: Custom path to the wasmtime executable. When empty, the extension looks for wasmtime on the system PATH.

hexana.wamrPath.description: Custom path to the iwasm (WAMR) executable. When empty, the extension looks for iwasm on the system PATH.

hexana.nodePath.description: Custom path to the Node.js executable. When empty, the extension looks for node on the system PATH.

hexana.wazeroPath.description: Custom path to the wazero executable. When empty, the extension looks for wazero on the system PATH.

hexana.graalVmHome.description: Path to a GraalVM installation directory. The extension compiles and runs a thin Java wrapper using 'bin/java' from this directory. The JDK must be a GraalVM distribution (it includes the WebAssembly engine on its module path). When empty, falls back to GRAALVM_HOME, then JAVA_HOME (if it is a GraalVM JDK), and finally scans common JVM installation directories automatically.

hexana.lldbDapPath.description: Custom path to the lldb-dap executable (LLDB's Debug Adapter Protocol server). When empty, the extension searches the system PATH and common LLVM installation directories.

hexana.lldbPath.description: Custom path to the lldb executable, used for WAMR remote debugging. When empty, the extension searches the system PATH.

hexana.showSemanticHighlighting.description: Show semantic highlighting in the hex viewer, coloring bytes by their structural section with labels and navigation arrows.

hexana.mcp.enabled.description: Register the downloaded Hexana MCP server in VS Code.

hexana.mcp.javaHome.description: Path to a Java 21 or later home used by the Hexana MCP server. Leave empty to use JAVA_HOME or java on PATH.

hexana.mcp.logLevel.description: Human-readable stderr logging level for the Hexana MCP server.

scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && npm --prefix test install && npm --prefix test run unit
scripts.obfuscate: javascript-obfuscator out/ --output out/ --compact true --string-array true --string-array-encoding rc4 --self-defending false --source-map false && javascript-obfuscator extension-lib/build/kotlin-webpack/js/productionExecutable/extension-lib.js --output extension-lib/build/kotlin-webpack/js/productionExecutable/extension-lib.js --compact true --string-array true --string-array-encoding rc4 --self-defending false --source-map false && javascript-obfuscator webview/build/kotlin-webpack/js/productionExecutable/webview.js --output webview/build/kotlin-webpack/js/productionExecutable/webview.js --compact true --string-array true --string-array-encoding rc4 --self-defending false --source-map false
